nodes.title: server/director/knows.js: the one pure reader (no I/O, no model, clock injected). planFor({ script, kit, skills, history, mixups, brief, interests, memory, now }) → { allKnown, opener, hookSlot, compress, firstCard, checkOrder, ladderOrder, prereqCheck, because }; per-turn remedyNow (the classifier's mix-up, else the authored target); topicFor (K5, K8: topic choice, made before a lesson exists); assertWalkExplained (the predicate tests use: a walk that departs from the script's default order or pick with no matching because record throws). knows-words.js turns because records into the parent's lines (Hinglish/English, 2+ shapes per kind, no ids). Not yet called by state.js or lesson.js (round 8 part D waits on Brain's v6.10).

evals/knows-her (deterministic, no model; n = 4 pilot topics × 5 simulated children, 2026-11-10): the no-history child gets exactly the script's default walk with an empty because on 4/4 topics; meera (skill 1 learned + delayed check, 12-day gap) vs kabir (last lesson closed badly, open ledger mix-up, wheel-spin with a cross-topic prerequisite where one exists, likes trains and drawing) differ in 5, 6, 6, 5 named ways (c4-ch05-t01, c5-ch02-t01, c5-ch02-t02, c6-ch06-t01), each traced to a learner fact; a games-only child (play: evidence) differs from the new child in 2 ways on every topic (first card, her mix-up's check first); every walk passes the because predicate and dropping any applied record makes it fail. Method limit: the walk is walk.mjs, a pure model of state.js's script walk, not the product's step(); the learner facts are fixtures in knows.js's input shape.

K3 (main's ruling 2026-11-10): her open ledger mix-up (needsVerify or p >= 0.7) changes what is ASKED: a check whose authored target is that mix-up is posed first among the skill's checks (because, source 'ledger'). Remediation answers only what she just showed: the mix-up the classifier named on that answer when the skill has a remediation for it, else the card's authored target. A ledger tier that remediated a mix-up the wrong answer did not show was built and dropped before merge. Reverse if a judged run shows the probe-first check repeatedly opening a skill on a card she cannot yet reach.

K7 (opener after a gap of 7+ days, from brief.opener or memory.lastActiveDay) is one easier card at the head of the warm-up, after any due delayed check (rj-truth-retention-order-starves-check); the plan's 'no new skill in the first three turns' is not built, because greet + warm-up already fill those turns in a scripted lesson. K2 (success first) chooses the same card slot (the easiest unseen kit item of a skill she has met) and also orders walked ladders easiest first. Reverse if a judged gap-return lesson reaches a new skill's explain inside its first three child turns.

K5 (no new skill before a test or in week one) and K8 (scripted topic first) cannot live in the lesson walk: the topic is chosen before planFor runs (reports/truth.js nextTopicOf → content/next-topic.js pickTopic / revisionPick, Learning's files). knows.js topicFor is the pure chooser; its call site is a patch to Learning. K6 likewise needs shared/interests.js (Learning's) to carry a per-interest `near` list; knows.js holds the table (NEAR) and reads the registry's `near` first once the patch lands.

Tried (round 8 Loop, before merge): remediating her open ledger mix-up instead of the card's authored target when the classifier named nothing on a wrong answer. What broke (design review, no run): it answers a mix-up the wrong answer did not show, e.g. a count-the-marks card missed gets the 'fractions are not numbers' remediation. Instead: the ledger mix-up's check is asked first (dc-r8-k3-ledger-asks-classifier-remediates).

Play alone never certifies a delayed check (the ledger's rule: a game row carries weight but is never the delayed check and never sets unaided), so a child whose record comes only from games can never have a skill compressed by K1. Her games still change the lesson: the first card (a met skill's easiest unseen item) and her open mix-up's check asked first (evals/knows-her, child 'player', 2 named differences on every pilot topic). Kept as is (main, 2026-11-10).
